edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier compares _owner against caller-controlled msg.sender before allowing ownership transfer
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender before renouncing ownership
burn is guarded only by an owner == msg.sender equality check performed by onlyOwner
_msgSender returns msg.sender which flows into ownership and transfer callers
block.timestamp drives timeElapsed and the TWAP branch condition, making price updates timestamp dependent
blockTimestampLast is read to compute timeElapsed inside _updateTwap
_updateTwap writes the new blockTimestamp into blockTimestampLast
priceCumulativeLast is read to compute the counterfactual average price
_updateTwap stores the fresh cumulative price into priceCumulativeLast
_updateTwap writes decoded average price into priceAverageLast
isThisToken0 selects which cumulative price feeds the average computation
minDeltaTwap gates whether the TWAP average is recomputed
uniswapPair is passed to the oracle library to read cumulative prices
amount parameter is used for balance subtraction and addition in _transfer
recipient parameter receives the credited balance in _transfer
transfer forwards execution to internal _transfer with msg.sender
transferFrom calls _transfer then updates allowance
_transfer mutates _balances for sender and recipient
transferFrom decreases the stored allowance for msg.sender
_address parameter selects which balance the burn overwrites
currentValue argument is used directly as the new balance value in burn
subtractValue argument is subtracted from currentValue in burn
burn assigns currentValue.sub(subtractValue) to _totalSupply, a fully caller-controlled supply rewrite
timeElapsed derived from block.timestamp is used as divisor in the TWAP average
priceCumulative minus priceCumulativeLast is computed unchecked before division
priceAverage local is stored into priceAverageLast
sendValue makes an external low-level call{value} to a recipient address that can re-enter before state settles

normalization_plan.reason: amount parameter only flows into internal _transfer balance arithmetic
recipient parameter is only consumed by internal _transfer
newOwner parameter is only used by transferOwnership
_address parameter is only used by the burn unsafe operation
currentValue parameter is only used by the burn unsafe operation
subtractValue parameter is only used by the burn unsafe operation
timeElapsed local is only used in the _updateTwap arithmetic operation
priceCumulative local is only used in the _updateTwap arithmetic operation
priceAverage local is only used inside _updateTwap to write priceAverageLast
